item.title: Mayhem rocks Mexico after most-wanted cartel boss is killed
item.description: MEXICO CITY — The Mexican government said it killed the nation’s most wanted cartel boss Sunday, setting off a wave of fires and violence across the country as cartel operatives sought to exact revenge in an unsettling show of force.

item.title: Trump mulls targeted strike against Iran, followed by larger attack
item.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump has told advisers that if diplomacy or any initial targeted U.S. attack does not lead Iran to give in to his demands that it give up its nuclear program, he will consider a much bigger attack in coming months intended to drive that country’s leaders from power, people briefed on internal administration deliberations said.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns, Knicks hold off Bulls
item.description: Karl-Anthony Towns had 28 points and 11 rebounds and Jalen Brunson added 19 points and nine assists to lift the visiting New York Knicks to a 105-99 win against the slumping Chicago Bulls on Sunday night.

item.title: ‘Everybody is pretty stoked’: Lady ‘Riders flag football ready to roll in 2026
item.description: KEALAKEHE — With a new BIIF girls flag football season officially underway, the Kealakehe Lady Waveriders are firing on all cylinders.

item.title: Winter Olympics Day 16 recap: US men win hockey gold; Eileen Gu defends freeski crown
item.description: Of course, it went to overtime. But this time it was the U.S. that minted a “Golden Goal” as Jack Hughes rocketed a shot into Canada’s net 1:41 into the three-on-three extra period to set off the celebration of America’s first hockey gold medal since the “Miracle on Ice” squad of U.S. amateurs brought home the prize in 1980.

item.title: Hawaii lawmakers look to space for economic diversification
item.description: State leaders are considering what could be a leap toward a decades-old goal of making the aerospace industry a big part of Hawaii’s economy.

item.title: Bill offering relief to primary care doctors fails to advance
item.description: A legislative bill backed by many of Hawaii’s primary care physicians to improve health care in the state has failed this session.

item.title: Trump aides project confidence on tariffs after court loss
item.description: WASHINGTON — The Trump administration signaled Sunday that it was on track to resurrect many of its punishing tariffs that were struck down by the Supreme Court, insisting that the new approach would fulfill President Donald Trump’s trade ambitions in a more legally durable way.
